BW_PossibleObjectClose_mm.blurb: Spatial threshold (mm) treating two possible-object observations as the same for remove/match; also maxLocDist for FindLocatedClosestMatchingObject and viz quad half-size (default 50).

BW_PossibleObjectClose_rad.blurb: Angular match tolerance (rad) for nearby known object vs new possible object (default π; comment suggests 2π may be better).

BW_MaxPossibleObjects.blurb: Cap on pending possible-object list; oldest popped when full (default 10).

FlatPosisbleObjectTol_deg.blurb: Max Z-axis angular deviation (deg) for an observation to count as flat enough to store as possible object (default 10). Dump id keeps source typo 'Posisble'.

BW_MaxHeightForPossibleObject_mm.blurb: Reject possible objects whose pose Z relative to robot exceeds this (mm) (default 30).

BW_DebugRenderPossibleObjects.blurb: If true, draw orange Viz quads for stored possible objects (default true).

BW_DebugRenderPossibleObjectsZ.blurb: Z lift (mm) applied to possible-object debug quads (default 35).
